title: Product — LucrumTech
description: Strategy, engineering, AI and technical leadership under one accountable team — not four vendors with four contracts and nobody answering for the result.
h1: Everything it takes to own a product — under one accountable team.
lede: Strategy, engineering, AI and technical leadership. Not four vendors with four contracts and nobody answering for the result.

blocks.p: We define what to build before a single line of code is written.
A delivery team we built and trained ourselves, led by people who have shipped before.
Executive-level technology leadership without the full-time overhead.
items: Architectural decisions and technical due diligence

blocks.p: Senior and mid-level engineers working inside your team, on your board and in your standups — with LucrumTech accountable for the work they do.
items: Embedded in your process, not run as a side project
Scale up or down without a new contract each time
One point of accountability for the output

note: Deepest experience: manufacturing and industrial automation, insurance and FinTech, HealthTech. Also shipped in SaaS, AdTech, Telecom, IoT and embedded systems.

pricing.h2: Two ways to work. We'll tell you which one you need.

blocks.p: Direct time with both of us — product and delivery, organisation, hiring. For a specific question, a decision you need a second opinion on, or a short review.
blocks.rate: Billed hourly, from USD 25 to USD 150 per hour depending on the role. No commitment, no minimum.

blocks.p: For work that needs owning rather than advising. One price covering the audit, the plan and the execution — leadership and delivery team included, not billed by the hour.
items: Full audit of what exists today
Our delivery team included in the price

start.p: Start with a two-week teardown — a written assessment of what we would do, what it takes and what it costs. If it isn't worth building, we say so.
start.priceNote: Fixed fee. The assessment is yours either way.

pricing.note: Most engagements start there. By the end of the two weeks we'll both know whether the package is the right call.

ai.h2: A demo proves it can work. Production proves it does.
ai.lede: Most AI projects die between the demo and the deployment. Something impressive gets built, everyone agrees it's the future, and a year later nothing is running in the business. The technology was rarely the problem.
ai.strong: That gap isn't a technology problem. It's an ownership problem.

blocks.p: The manual steps in a workflow: reading documents, extracting data, moving it between systems.
items: Document parsing and data extraction at volume
Call and meeting transcription into structured records
Routing and triage inside existing workflows

blocks.p: Changing how a process works, not just making the current version faster.
items: Copilots embedded where the work actually happens
Rebuilding a process around what AI makes possible

blocks.p: Processes you already run, made measurably better.
items: Cost and latency tuning on existing AI systems
Replacing brittle rules with models where it pays
Taking a stalled pilot the rest of the way
